title: Social network composition of vascular patients and its associates with health behavior and clinical risk factors.
descriptions: Patients’ health behaviors have an important role in cardiovascular risk management (CRVM). This study aimed to explore linkages of patients’ social network composition with health behaviors and clinical risk factors.

The data file contains 33 respondents more than the 657 mentioned in 'Summary of the study'. This is due to the fact that 33 respondent have been excluded from the analysis. The raw data of the alters are not present in the data file.
